# HowStuffWorks Money

> Comprehensive resource explaining personal finance, business, economics, and investment fundamentals through accessible guides and analysis.

HowStuffWorks Money covers the full spectrum of financial topics from budgeting and credit management to cryptocurrency, corporate strategy, and market analysis. The site combines practical personal finance advice with broader economic education and business trend reporting.

## Key Topics

- Personal Finance
- Business Management
- Cryptocurrency
- Investment
- Market Capitalization
- AI Companies
- Economics
- Wealth Building
- Corporate Transformation
- Consumer Guide
- Tech Companies
- Business News
- Blockchain
- Stock Market

## Core Channels

- [Business & Money Homepage](https://money.howstuffworks.com): HowStuffWorks Money Channel homepage covering finance, business, economics, and investment topics.
- [Personal Finance](https://money.howstuffworks.com/personal-finance): Personal Finance Channel hub covering budgeting, credit, insurance, banking, and money management.
- [Business](https://money.howstuffworks.com/business-management-channel.htm): Business Channel hub covering management, entrepreneurship, career advice, and workplace guides.
- [Economics](https://money.howstuffworks.com/money-economics-basics-channel.htm): Economics Channel hub explaining fundamentals of currency, GDP, capitalism, and cryptocurrency.
- [Jobs](https://money.howstuffworks.com/jobs-channel.htm): Jobs Channel exploring job search, career guidance, remote work, and workplace wellness.

## Technology & Investment

- [10 Biggest AI Companies Determining the Future of Everything](https://money.howstuffworks.com/biggest-ai-companies.htm): Ranking of leading AI companies including Microsoft, Alphabet, Google, Meta, and OpenAI.
- [The 10 Highest-Valued Companies Aren't All What You Think](https://money.howstuffworks.com/highest-valued-companies.htm): Analysis of market capitalization leaders Apple, Microsoft, Saudi Aramco, and Alphabet.
- [The 5 Best AI Stock Pickers for 2026: Beat the Market While You Sleep?](https://money.howstuffworks.com/kavout-best-ai-stock-pickers.htm): Comparison of AI-powered investment tools like Kavout and algorithmic stock picking platforms.
- [10 Types of Cryptocurrency for Transactions vs. Stored Value](https://money.howstuffworks.com/types-of-cryptocurrency.htm): Guide to cryptocurrency types, blockchain technology, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital assets.

## Business & Corporate Strategy

- [12 Companies That Completely Reinvented Themselves](https://money.howstuffworks.com/10-companies-reinvented-themselves.htm): Guide exploring corporate transformations of Western Union, American Express, Shell, LG, and Berkshire Hathaway.
- [Youngest Self-made Billionaire and 3 Exceptional Runners-up](https://money.howstuffworks.com/youngest-self-made-billionaire.htm): Profile of youngest self-made billionaires including Alexandr Wang and tech entrepreneurs.
- [9 Worst Airlines: Domestic, International, and Budget Airlines to Avoid](https://money.howstuffworks.com/worst-airlines.htm): Ranking and comparison of worst-performing airlines by customer satisfaction and reliability.

## Economics & Global Markets

- [What Is Universal Basic Income, and Does It Work?](https://money.howstuffworks.com/universal-basic-income.htm): Explainer on universal basic income pilot programs and economic policy implications.
- [What Country Has the Most Oil? It's Not in the Middle East](https://money.howstuffworks.com/what-country-has-the-most-oil.htm): Comparative analysis of global oil reserves and production across Venezuela, Saudi Arabia, and others.

## Real Estate & Property Investment

- [10 Landlord-friendly States (Spoiler: No West Coast Candidates)](https://money.howstuffworks.com/landlord-friendly-states.htm): State comparison guide for real estate investors covering eviction laws and rental property regulations.

## Consumer Guides & Everyday Economics

- [What's the Difference Between a Restaurant Service Charge and a Tip?](https://money.howstuffworks.com/restaurant-service-charge-vs-tip.htm): Guide explaining differences between service charges and tips in restaurant billing practices.
- [What Do the Numbers on Those Tiny Produce Stickers Tell Us?](https://money.howstuffworks.com/numbers-produce-stickers.htm): Consumer guide explaining PLU codes on produce stickers and food labeling standards.
- [Cheapest Cigarettes by State: Where Average Cigarette Prices Haven't Skyrocketed](https://money.howstuffworks.com/personal-finance/personal-income-taxes/cheapest-cigarettes-by-state.htm): State-by-state comparison of cigarette prices and excise tax impacts on consumer costs.

## Optional

- [Why Do Americans Sell Soda by the Liter but Milk by the Gallon?](https://money.howstuffworks.com/why-sell-soda-liter-milk-gallon.htm): Analysis of metric vs. imperial measurement systems in product packaging and marketing.
- [What Happened to SoBe Drinks?](https://money.howstuffworks.com/what-happened-to-sobe-drinks.htm): History of SoBe beverage brand discontinuation and PepsiCo acquisition impact.
